verdict.rationale: Ironclad is a contract-lifecycle platform with its own AI features, so letting users connect MCP servers as tool sources is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions MCP client support or any way to plug external MCP servers into Ironclad's AI. The REST APIs, webhooks, and integration docs are developer building blocks for external apps calling Ironclad, not Ironclad consuming MCP tools, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
